import io,json,re,tarfile,urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(".cache/literature/rxnfp_2012.06051v1.src")
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
if not p.exists():
    with urllib.request.urlopen("https://arxiv.org/src/2012.06051v1",timeout=45) as response:
        p.write_bytes(response.read(30000000))
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(p.read_bytes()),mode="r:*") as archive:
    for member in archive.getmembers():
        if member.name.endswith(".tex") and member.size<3000000:
            f=archive.extractfile(member)
            content=f.read().decode("utf-8",errors="replace")
            for match in re.finditer(r"Pistachio|2[.,]6|pre.train",content,re.I):
                print(json.dumps({"file":member.name,"excerpt":content[max(0,match.start()-140):match.end()+300]}))
